from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,os,time,datetime
r=Path('/mnt/e/tmp/wse-focused-pairs-repeat2-20261004');old=Path('/mnt/e/tmp/wse-final-remeasure-20261004')
node=old/'node-v22.13.0-linux-x64/bin/node'
subprocess.run(['python3',str(old/'scripts/fingerprint.py'),'--verify'],check=True)
files=[r/'protocol.json',r/'run.py',r/'host-load.ps1']+list((r/'harness').glob('*.mjs'))
frozen={str(p.relative_to(r)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
(r/'frozen.json').write_text(json.dumps(frozen,indent=2)+'\n')
protocol=json.loads((r/'protocol.json').read_text())
cases=[('SingleThreadDownloader', 'buffered'), ('SingleThreadDownloader', 'streamed'), ('MultiThreadDownloader', 'streamed'), ('SingleThreadDownloader', 'local'), ('SingleThreadDownloader', 'markup')]
record={'startedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'protocol':protocol,'cases':[],'status':'running'}
ps='/mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe'
def check_host(label):
 p=r/'logs'/('host-'+label+'.json')
 with p.open('wb') as out:
  subprocess.run([ps,'-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',r'E:\tmp\wse-focused-pairs-repeat2-20261004\host-load.ps1'],stdout=out,check=True,timeout=45)
 data=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
 quiet=all(s['cpuPercent']<=10 and all(d['CurrentDiskQueueLength']<=1 for d in s['disks']) for s in data)
 return {'path':str(p),'quiet':quiet,'samples':data}
try:
 for mode,workload in cases:
  name=mode+'-'+workload
  host=[];start=time.monotonic()
  while True:
   status=check_host(name+'-'+str(len(host)));host.append(status)
   if status['quiet'] or time.monotonic()-start>=300:break
   print(name,'waiting for quiet host; CPU',[s['cpuPercent'] for s in status['samples']],flush=True)
   time.sleep(15)
  result=r/'runs'/(name+'.json')
  print('START',name,'quiet=',status['quiet'],flush=True)
  with (r/'logs'/(name+'.stdout')).open('wb') as out,(r/'logs'/(name+'.stderr')).open('wb') as err:
   completed=subprocess.run([str(node),'--expose-gc',str(r/'harness/focused.mjs'),mode,workload,str(result)],stdout=out,stderr=err,timeout=600)
  assert completed.returncode==0,name+' failed'
  data=json.loads(result.read_text());assert data['status']!='failed'
  record['cases'].append({'case':data['case'],'hostBefore':host,'result':data})
  (r/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
  print('DONE',name,data['status'],'rounds',data['acceptedRounds'],'effect',data.get('currentVsLegacyPercent'),flush=True)
 record['hostAfter']=check_host('after')
 record['finishedAt']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();record['status']='complete'
 for name,h in frozen.items():assert hashlib.sha256((r/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,name
 (r/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
 print('Focused measurement complete.',flush=True)
except BaseException as e:
 record['status']='failed';record['error']=str(e)
 (r/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n');raise

protocol.scope: Second user-requested independent repeat of the same five failed-control cases; unchanged numerical protocol, no pooling or replacement
protocol.order: Six permutations repeated three times; second observation reverses the first order within each round

noise.calibrationOrder: Three rotations, each variant occupies each position once
noise.calibrationContext: Same six observations in one process as measured rounds; three rotations; discarded calibration timings
noise.groupStatistic: Maximum of 12 bracketing probe values per metric and six-observation round
noise.threshold: Per case and metric: 1.5 times the median of three independent calibration group maxima; fixed before measured rounds. This is a heuristic outlier guard, not a calibrated false-positive probability.
noise.ioProbe: 8 sequential stat + readFile pairs on an independent 4 KiB fixture, same filesystem as workload
noise.filter: Discard complete three-variant round for a case when its CPU or I/O group maximum exceeds that case-specific threshold; never use crawl timing, paired effect or candidate performance for exclusion

statistics.unit: Median of two observations per variant within each paired round
statistics.control: 95% interval includes zero and lies within [-5,+5] percent
statistics.classification: Report faster/slower only when current/control stability passes and both current-vs-legacy and identical-current-vs-legacy intervals have that sign; otherwise unresolved. No universal non-regression claim.

protocol.stopping: Exactly three calibration rounds then 18 measured rounds per case. Abort on functional mismatch. No extra rounds, threshold changes or pooling.
protocol.timing: One dedicated process per case, both APIs warmed twice; each observation creates, initializes, runs and disposes a new crawler, including worker startup. Baseline and two observations of the same current API alternate closely. Imports/JIT and caches are warmed, so results do not establish cold-start performance.
